family.theme: Flying-squirrel gliding and maple-samara autorotation: a large-eyed canopy youngster unfolds soft paired membranes into broad turning surfaces and steers with its maple-key tail, carrying fictional seed-dispersal winds through the treetops.
family.habitat: Hardwood forest margins and tree hollows, active at dusk/night. Proposed tree-canopy or Headbutt habitats along MN_R01 and wooded MN_R05 margins; no new map or encounter registration.

members.name: Whirlnut
members.body_growth: Small round-eared mouse-like flying squirrel, huge expressive eyes, small folded wrist-to-ankle patagia that form two short rounded lobes at its sides. A broad flattened maple-key tail curves beside the body with one rounded paddle tip and a nutlet-like thick root. It can unfold the lobes for a short controlled spiral descent.
members.silhouette: Cute large round head and tiny paws, paired folded teardrop side flaps and a short rounded key-shaped steering tail.

members.name: Samurrel
members.body_growth: Two broad samara-shaped gliding membranes stretch continuously from wrist to ankle; each has a thick rounded outer leading lobe and tapered trailing fold. It banks in an asymmetric turning glide, one membrane high/open and the other lower/curved. The flattened steering tail broadens into a long rounded maple-key paddle, visibly counterturning behind its cute central squirrel head/body. Huge eyes and rounded ears remain.
members.silhouette: Two broad unequal-height maple-key patagia around a compact big-eyed squirrel, small feet on membrane corners and one flattened countersteering tail.

family.sprite_design: Actual cute mouse-like flying-squirrel anatomy; no Electric cheek patches or lightning, costumes, bags, held seeds, wings separate from body or ordinary squirrel wearing leaf gear. Paired samara membranes are living wrist-to-ankle anatomy; tail is an integral rounded steering paddle. Coarse four-ink tan/cocoa pixel planes; large readable eyes. Fronts56x56 full, backs48x48 close head/shoulder and near membrane, lower body cropped. Each species own palette.

sources.supports: Both northern and southern flying squirrels occur in Minnesota; broad planing membrane extends front to hind feet, flattened tail and large eyes, tree-hollow/forest habitat.
sources.fantasy_extension: The maple-key tail and samara-shaped autorotating patagia/seed-dispersal winds are original monster anatomy/powers, not documented squirrel behavior.

sources.supports: Sugar-maple seeds form paired slightly connected winged samaras carried by wind; sugar maple grows in cool rich eastern Minnesota locations.
sources.fantasy_extension: The creature borrows the paired seed-wing silhouette; it is neither a plant costume nor a claim of natural squirrel-controlled autorotation.

family.implementation_boundary: Original authoring proposal and sprite candidate only. Root owns roster, registry, palettes and any gameplay registration.
